notes.title: Aza v. 0.0.2 Patch notes
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes/Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Adjusted when hurtbox turns back on during dash.
[*] Passives skills effects are now applied.
[*] Adjusted camera sensitivity.
[*] Made a way to not select a passive so you can save your gems.
[*] Made a new control scheme for when your on reward canvas, so you can un-pause the game and move around when on the reward screen.
[*] Lock on just got fixed.
[*] Punching animation was sped up.
[*] Heal regen passives was fixed.
[*] Fixed weird bug where buying a skill wouldn't make it enabled just yet in the equipment page if you already opened the page prior to buying skills.
[*] Weaken mage beam attack.
[*] You can exit out of passive rewards at the end of the level, to save gems.
[*] Removed Aura burst and Blast orb skills.
[*] Adjusted Mp cost of skills.
[/olist]

[h1]Upcoming[/h1]
A damage counter.
More visual cues for attacks.
More VFX on certain attacks and hit reactions.
5 More skills to buy.
3 new Transformations for ultimate's skill menu.
3 new Ultimate attacks.
4 more levels.
Inflation of prices for skills and passives.(Beware)
Fully implemented Keyboard and Mouse controls.
New Parry animation.
Customization for Sword skills.
4 new Sword skills.

notes.title: Patch notes Hot fix #1
notes.content:
There was a bug that prevented players from going through the passive selector menu. Its now fixed! 

Working on making indication of pressing the east face button to continue to next level.
